messages.content: The feeling that your past experiences have left you unfixable or "broken" is incredibly painful, but it doesn't mean you can't heal or that your identity is destroyed. Many people feel a profound sense of loss in their identity after trauma, yet it is still possible to find new ways to piece their lives together, even when those pieces don't look like they used to. You do not have to carry this feeling alone, and reaching out to a mental health professional who specializes in trauma could offer a space where you feel truly understood.
